Multiple Road Accidents Across India Claim Lives and Cause Injuries

Several road accidents have been reported across India, resulting in fatalities and injuries. Incidents include collisions between vehicles, a truck ramming a motorcycle, and a car going airborne after a tyre burst. Investigations have been initiated in some cases, with police registering cases and launching probes into the circumstances of the crashes.
